title: DealLedgerVerdict
description: Structured output from a PrizeIncubator agent run — feeds Telegram, the dashboard, and the demo narrative.

product.description: Product title as displayed on the e-commerce site

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this verdict was produced

listed_price.description: Price shown on the product page (before coupons/bank offers)

true_final_price.description: Actual price after applying best available coupon + bank offer

applied_coupon.description: Coupon code that was successfully applied, or null if none

bank_offer.description: Description of the best bank offer found, or null if none

serviceable.description: Whether the product is deliverable to this pincode

eta.description: Estimated delivery date (ISO 8601 date), null if not serviceable

90_day_low.description: Lowest price in the last 90 days

90_day_high.description: Highest price in the last 90 days

percentile.description: Current price's percentile within the 90-day range (lower = better deal)

reasoning.description: Plain-language explanation of why this verdict was reached

issue.description: What went wrong (e.g. coupon_expired, pincode_not_serviceable, selector_changed, captcha_blocked)

action.description: What the agent did in response

recovery_events.description: Log of failures encountered and recovery actions taken during the agent run
